provenance.note: Base single-journey fare (Monday to Saturday column) read from DMRC fare table at https://delhimetrorail.com/fare. Published bands: '0-2', '2-5', '5-12', '12-21', '21-32', 'More than 32'. Band edge wording is ambiguous versus our [min,max) bands. Official page states no effective date. Sunday/holiday discounted fares, smart cards, and Airport Express (station-to-station matrix) excluded. Caveat: del-pink Phase 4 distance estimates are unreliable.

Standard single-journey fare table (Fare After Discount column) from official press release L&TMRHL/CCD/PR/189/23-05-2025 published by L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited, effective 2025-05-24 across all fare media (Paper QR/Token, Digital Tickets, Smart Cards). Slabs reflect a 10% discount on the FFC percentage increase with rounding to nearest rupee; superseded 17 May 2025 chart is not used. Band boundary semantics in document are upper-inclusive ('Up to 2', 'More than 2 up to 4', etc.) whereas calculator uses half-open [min, max) intervals; computed_route_km approximates actual chainage distance.
